title: Fleet management system
summary: A fleet management back end: cloud hosting, fleet telemetry and route distances in sequence, then either the classic routing path (80%) or a quantum optimiser (20%), then payment. Hand-made candidates with cost, execution time, availability, reliability and security; no offering, so no margins.
